problem.description: Cross-audit of the A09–A14 analysis lessons found two diagram presentation gaps in A09/A10.
symptoms: A09 SVG omitted voltage polarity signs across R0/R1/R2 although the lesson teaches signed voltage drops
At narrow viewports the 560px A09/A10 SVGs scaled down, reducing diagram labels to approximately 6–9px

investigation.root_cause: The first diagrams relied on prose for resistor polarities and used the generic responsive image rule, which shrank embedded SVG text.

0 confirmed P0/P1/P2, electrical topology and arithmetic consistent
0 confirmed P0/P1/P2, RC/RL/RLC results and SVG topology consistent
A09–A14 ideal DC, transient and AC reference numbers match independent calculations

changes: Marked positive and negative resistor voltage reference ends in a09.svg and its accessible description
Wrapped A09–A14 SVGs in keyboard-focusable horizontal-scroll regions and preserved native diagram size with CSS
Kept text transcripts and full-size SVG links next to each figure
resolution.remaining: No SPICE, ERC, physical measurements or part-specific thermal/EMC validation is claimed.
